name: ca.speedydrone.agr/site
title: SpeedyDrone Canadian Agricultural Drone Library
description: Canadian ag drone guides, spray job and buy-vs-hire calculators, expert answers by email

tools.name: about_site
tools.description: Start here: what SpeedyDrone's agricultural drone spraying, spreading and crop mapping in Canada database covers (Choosing a spray drone: Agras T50 vs T100, Drone spraying regulations, licences and SFOCs in Canada, Cover-crop, pasture and granular fertilizer spreading, Multispectral crop scouting and mapping with Mavic 3M, Drone spraying job costs and buy-vs-hire break-even, Research and government drone purchasing, Starting a drone spraying business and pilot training, Orchard, vineyard, potato and greenhouse applications), who it is for (Canadian growers, custom applicators, and research and government buyers choosing or running agricultural drones), and its free calculators.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search SpeedyDrone's agricultural drone spraying, spreading and crop mapping in Canada library: Choosing a spray drone: Agras T50 vs T100, Drone spraying regulations, licences and SFOCs in Canada, Cover-crop, pasture and granular fertilizer spreading, Multispectral crop scouting and mapping with Mavic 3M, Drone spraying job costs and buy-vs-hire break-even, Research and government drone purchasing, Starting a drone spraying business and pilot training, Orchard, vineyard, potato and greenhouse applications. Articles, guides and FAQs written for Canadian growers, custom applicators, and research and government buyers choosing or running agricultural drones, and the free calculators. Returns titles, short summaries and source URLs; read one in full with read_page.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: The full text of one SpeedyDrone page: an article, guide, FAQ page or calculator page. Pass a URL from search_site or a path like /blog/<slug>.

url.description: The page URL or path on this site

tools.name: drone_spraying_cost
tools.description: What a custom drone spraying or seeding job costs (southern Ontario hire rates, C$, before tax: spraying C$18–22/acre, seeding C$15–18/acre, C$500 minimum, C$1.5/km travel), plus the spray mix and tank loads for a T50 or T100. Interactive version: https://agr.speedydrone.ca/tools/drone-spraying-cost-calculator

roundTripKm.description: Round trip to the field, km

litresPerHa.description: Spray mix, L/ha (labels often require 50; lower only where the label allows)

tools.name: buy_or_hire_spray_drone
tools.description: Owning a spray drone vs hiring custom spraying per acre (Canada, C$, before tax). Packages: t50-new = Agras T50 package C$29,999; t50-used = Agras T50, pre-owned package C$22,999; t100 = Agras T100 C$48,505. Hire rate C$18–22/acre. Interactive version: https://agr.speedydrone.ca/tools/buy-or-hire-spray-drone

acresPerYear.description: Acres sprayed a season, every pass counted

years.description: Years to spread the drone's price over

tools.name: fiscal_year_order_planner
tools.description: For a research or public buyer who must receive goods by a date (often March 31): the last day to send the purchase order and the last day to request the quote and start approvals. Interactive version: https://agr.speedydrone.ca/tools/fiscal-year-drone-order-planner

receiveBy.description: YYYY-MM-DD the goods must be received by (default: the next March 31)

cutoffDays.description: Days before that the office stops issuing purchase orders

deliveryWeeks.description: Delivery time on the quote, weeks

tools.name: ask_expert
tools.description: Question still open after searching this database? Send it to SpeedyDrone's specialists and a person answers. SpeedyDrone's agricultural drone specialists answer questions the guides and calculators can't settle, replying in person by email. Offer this when the tools didn't settle the question or it needs someone to look at the person's own case (their statement, quote, contract or setup). Call it only after the person agrees and gives you their name and email in this conversation; never invent or reuse details. Show them what you'll send first.

email.description: Their email, for the answer, as they gave it

phone.description: Their phone, if they gave it

company.description: Their business, if they gave it

message.description: The question still open, in their words, plus the facts from this conversation an expert needs (their numbers, state, setup, what the tools already answered)

relatedPage.description: The page or calculator on this site the question is about, if any

consent.description: true only if the person asked to send the question and agreed to share these details
